# Increase in timeouts for some unauthenticated users

## What Changed

Nov 8, 12:32 UTC Resolved - On November 8, 2026, between 08:43 and 12:29 UTC, unauthenticated requests to github.com and the GitHub REST API experienced elevated error rates. During this period, 11.3% of unauthenticated requests and 46.1% of release asset download requests failed. Authenticated requests were largely unaffected. Initial errors occurred in a backend service handling unauthenticated web traffic. A subsequent traffic spike caused high CPU utilization on servers in our caching layer. Some servers remained unhealthy after the spike ended, prolonging the disruption. We restored service by restarting caching software and rebooting affected servers. We are improving monitoring to detect these failures sooner, investigating why affected servers did not recover automatically, and reviewing caching behavior to better protect backend services during failures. Nov 8, 12:29 UTC Monitoring - The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Nov 8, 11:56 UTC Update - The degradation affecting API Requests has been mitigated.
